chunks: Muhammad ibn Ibrahim ibn Ishaq al-Talaqani (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Hamadani narrated to us. He said: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal narrated to us, from his father, from Marwan ibn Muslim, from al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him). He said: My father narrated to me, from his father, from his grandfather (peace be upon them). He said: The Messenger of God (may God bless him and his family) said:

Sha'ban is my month, and Ramadan is the month of God, Mighty and Majestic. So whoever fasts a day in my month, I will be his intercessor on the Day of Resurrection. And whoever fasts the month of Ramadan shall be freed from the Fire.

key_terms.القيامة: The Resurrection, the Day of Judgment
key_terms.رمضان: Ramadan, the ninth month of the Islamic calendar in which fasting is obligatory
key_terms.شعبان: Sha'ban, the eighth month of the Islamic calendar preceding Ramadan
key_terms.شفيع: Intercessor, one who intercedes on behalf of another

ai.seo_question: What is the virtue of fasting in Sha'ban according to the Prophet Muhammad?
ai.summary: In this prophetic tradition narrated through the chain of Imams back to the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW), the Prophet designates Sha'ban as his personal month and Ramadan as God's month. This hadith was delivered in the context of encouraging believers to fast voluntarily during Sha'ban as preparation for the obligatory fasting of Ramadan. The Prophet promises his personal intercession on the Day of Judgment for anyone who fasts even one day of Sha'ban, while fasting the entirety of Ramadan grants deliverance from Hellfire.
